messages:
monitoring-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert triggered 3023456789 - PrivConn AZ-C: broad failures for PrivateLink endpoints. Symptoms: ~60% TCP RSTs on Service ASGs, internal resolver cluster returning NXDOMAIN for *.priv-svc.az-c.internal. Auto-escalation to #incidents.

Maria G: Paging @Nate R and @Jaya P — I'm looking. Any infra deploys to az-c in last 15m? :eyes:

Nate R: nothing on deploys. Triage note: router logs show repeated BGP withdraws for our private ranges. grep shows entries like `BGP UPDATE: Withdrawn 10.248.0.0/16` starting ~3023456798.

Jaya P: I'm on network. CS is seeing CustomerA and CustomerB TLS handshake failures to PrivateLink -> connection resets. CS-Emily: "CustomerA started seeing errors ~3-4m ago, ~50% fail rate". Opening bridge: https://bridge.redwood/incident/3023456789

oncall-bot: Handoff requested. Current on-call: Maria G. Suggested next on-call: Nate R.

Maria G: I'll own customer comms. Paging Nate to accept handoff.

Nate R: ack, claiming. Initial plan: 1) identify flapping BGP neighbor(s); 2) soft-reset neighbors individually to avoid large-scale withdraws; 3) if instability continues, announce standby prefixes from az-d and fail over PrivateLink ASGs; 4) investigate DNS resolver negative-cache storm.

NetOps: note — az-c internal resolver cluster (resolv-azc-*) is showing high memory pressure and many negative-cache entries. Upstream CA timeouts correlated with NXDOMAINs. Could be contributing.

Jaya P: `show bgp neighbors` on rtr-azc-edge1 shows neighbor 198.51.100.34 in ERR/Connect, flapping every ~18-22s. Planning `clear ip bgp 198.51.100.34 soft` but will throttle.

Nate R: do soft clears one-by-one and watch route-watcher. If we see mass withdraws on clear, revert and try local dampening adjustments. Preparing to temporarily raise BGP hold-time on az-c edges to reduce sensitivity.

Jaya P: executing soft clear on rtr-azc-edge1 at 3023456865. Commands: 
```
# rtr-azc-edge1
show bgp neighbors 198.51.100.34
clear ip bgp 198.51.100.34 soft
```

NetOps: edge1 adjacency stabilized after the soft clear; edge2 still flapping. Investigating physical link between our edge and transit peer.

deploy-bot: No active infra deploys to az-c. All autopromotions paused for incident.

Jaya P: applied BGP hold-time bump from 60s -> 180s on edge group at 3023456932 to absorb transient neighbor blips. Will monitor.

NetOps: restarted one resolver pod to recover memory and clear negative cache entries. Commands used:
```
kubectl delete pod resolv-azc-3 -n infra-resolver
# admin API call to clear negative cache
POST /admin/clear_negative_cache
```

Nate R: after soft clears, hold-time increase, and resolver pod restart: BGP stabilized across edges and withdrawn prefixes were re-advertised. Route-watcher shows privatelink prefixes present from az-c again.

Jaya P: PrivateLink ASG healthchecks recovering. TCP handshake success climbed from ~35% to ~92% in ~3m.

CS-Emily: CustomerA confirms errors dropping and traffic returning to normal. CustomerB reports similar improvement. They requested RCA and timeline notes.

Maria G: drafting customer-facing incident summary and will include timeline, mitigation steps, and next steps for follow-up.

Nate R: post-incident actions: 1) keep raised BGP hold-times for 30m then step down incrementally; 2) increase resolver memory and add alert for negative-cache spike; 3) open INFRA-7832 to investigate transit peer 198.51.100.34 hardware/interface flaps; 4) schedule controlled failover test to az-d standby.

BridgeBot: Incident bridge recorded: https://bridge.redwood/incident/3023456789

oncall-bot: Handoff complete. Primary on-call now Nate R. Maria G remains incident commander for customer comms.

monitoring-bot: Metrics update at 3023457260 — PrivateLink handshake success (az-c) 95%. DNS NXDOMAIN rate back to baseline. Leaving incident in P1 for RCA.

Maria G: incident mitigated for now. Keeping channel open 30m for monitoring, then will prepare detailed RCA. Great work everyone :trophy:

Nate R: created INFRA-7832 for transit peer investigation and logged remediation steps.

NetOps: increased resolver memory request and added temporary alerts. Will push config during next maintenance window.

CS-Emily: notified CustomerA and CustomerB; they requested a follow-up call tomorrow to review RCA and preventive measures.

monitoring-bot: Incident update logged at 3023457580 — Mitigated, monitoring. Bridge scheduled to close in 30m unless regressions.
